chunks: Muhammad b. al-Hasan b. Ahmad b. al-Walid (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to us from Muhammad b. 'Isa b. 'Ubayd from 'Ubaydullah b. 'Abdullah al-Dahqan from Darast b. Abi Mansur from 'Abdullah b. Sinan. He said: Al-Sadiq Ja'far b. Muhammad (peace be upon them both) said:
Do not use basil twigs nor pomegranate twigs as toothpicks, for they both irritate the vein of leprosy.

key_terms.تتخللوا: Using a toothpick (takhallul) - cleaning between the teeth with a stick

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about using basil and pomegranate twigs as toothpicks?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) issues a specific health-related prohibition against using basil and pomegranate twigs as toothpicks, stating that both irritate 'the vein of leprosy.' This ruling reflects the Imam's guidance on preventive health practices in daily life, a topic frequently addressed in hadith literature alongside spiritual rulings.
